market.shares_basis: Issued-share conservative denominator. Includes treasury shares, not a verified current net outstanding count. KSEI total as of 16 October 2026.

limitations: Illustrative academic valuation, not an independently verified transaction valuation. Forecasts, WACC and asset recoveries are analyst assumptions.
Valuation date is 19 October 2026. Balance sheet is 30 September 2026; no stub cash-flow adjustment for the 19-day lag.
Interims are unaudited. Corrected Q2 is used. Q1 and Q2 comparison periods may not incorporate all later classifications.
Issued shares include treasury shares. A verified net share count and potential dilution schedule remain outstanding.
Peer multiples are secondary-vendor Current/TTM snapshots, rounded and not fully harmonized for leases, periods or nonrecurring items. UNTR snapshot is a day later and excluded by default.
Exploration value is a recovery scenario of carrying value less acquisition deferred tax, not a reserve-based NAV. No production plan, reserve audit or project development capex is available.
Other borrowings include lease/equipment finance. All are treated as debt-like conservatively. Noncash lease capex is an explicit forecast allowance.
All non-operating other gains/losses are excluded from recurring EBIT. Some recurring costs could be hidden there. No tax-adjusted normalized net income is asserted.
Operating NWC uses a simplified ratio. A temporary working-capital release is not capitalized as perpetual growth.
Monte Carlo percentiles describe assumed inputs, not statistical confidence intervals or measured probabilities of investment success.
